Subject: Post-call recap + kickoff checklist (EdgeOps trial)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

- Goals we agreed: validate 95th percentile latency for the aggregation pipeline and measure per-token cost on a 10k/day synthetic workload.
- Trial scope: 2 vGPU endpoints (g4x2-equivalent), 30-day trial, sample dataset ingest and two prompt templates (search + rerank).
- Known constraints on your side: IT needs to approve outbound IPs and Aisha will provision a sandbox service account.

To keep things moving I attached a short kickoff checklist (trial-kickoff-checklist.pdf) — the minimal items we need from your side are:
1) Confirm sandbox service account (or tell us if you want Redwood-generated temporary credentials)
2) Whitelist Redwood egress IPs (see ip-allowlist-steps.txt)
3) Share a small sample dataset or S3 path and the prompt templates you want to test

Proposed next steps (pick one):
- I can schedule a 45-min onboarding session this week with Marissa (CS) to walk through deployment + telemetry.
- Or we drop in temporarily with temporary credentials and run a smoke test; we’ll keep the environment off public access until you’re ready.

If this is still a priority for EdgeOps, can you confirm which option works and whether IT needs anything else from us? If timing has shifted, let me know and we’ll pause/extend the trial window.

Thanks — Ben
